content: The TCT 2014 schedule outlines the coordination of television events during the conference. Open time slots are marked in red. The filming location is the Grand Lobby of the Walter E. Washington Convention Center, located at 801 Mt Vernon Pl NW, Washington, DC 20001. Saturday, September 13, 2014 9:00 AM: Open time slot. 9:30 AM: Open time slot. 10:00 AM: Scheduled session. 10:30 AM: Scheduled session. 11:00 AM: Open time slot. 11:30 AM: Open time slot. 12:00 PM 12:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Gary Mintz on the topic of the TCT Program Director Interview (specific topic to be determined). 1:30 PM: Open time slot. 2:00 PM 2:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Stefanie Schulz discussing the ISAR-CLOSURE trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing two vascular closure devices versus manual compression after femoral artery access. (Embargo lifts at 12:30 PM on September 13, 2014.) 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Interview with Dr. George Dangas on the TCT Program Director Interview (specific topic to be determined). 3:00 PM: Open time slot. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Shao Liang Chen on the DKCRUSH-VI trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing FFR-guided versus angiography-guided provisional T-stenting in patients with true coronary bifurcation lesions. (Embargo lifts at 12:00 PM on September 14, 2014.) 4:00 PM 4:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Juan Granada on the TCT Program Director Interview (specific topic to be determined). 4:30 PM 5:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Steven Yakubov discussing the CoreValve US Pivotal Trial, presenting two-year results of a self-expanding bioprosthesis in extremely high-risk patients with aortic stenosis. (Embargo lifts at 12:30 PM on September 13, 2014.) 5:00 PM 5:30 PM: Interview with Dr. William Gray on the TCT Program Director Interview (specific topic to be determined). 5:30 PM 6:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Ajay Kirtane providing the TCT Daily Wrap-Up. Sunday, September 14, 2014 9:00 AM 9:15 AM: Open time slot. 9:15 AM 9:30 AM: Interview with Dr. E. Magnus Ohman and Dr. Germano Di Sciascio on the TCT Crossfire debate: Is adequate pretreatment with P2Y12 antagonists beneficial before PCI in most settings? (Embargo lifts at 3:38 PM on September 14, 2014.) 9:30 AM 10:00 AM: Interview with Prof. Freek Verheugt on the TCT Wrap-Up from a Netherlands perspective. 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Roxana Mehran on the TCT Program Director Interview (specific topic to be determined). 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Antonio Colombo discussing the SECURITY trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing six months versus twelve months of dual antiplatelet therapy following coronary drug-eluting stent implantation. (Embargo lifts at 12:06 PM on September 15, 2014.) 12:00 PM 12:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Matthew Reynolds on the US CoreValve High-Risk Trial, focusing on cost-effectiveness analysis from a prospective, randomized trial of transcatheter aortic valve replacement with a self-expanding device versus surgical aortic valve replacement in high-risk patients with aortic stenosis. (Embargo lifts at 12:00 PM on September 13, 2014.) 2:00 PM 2:30 PM: Interview with Prof. Colin Berry discussing the British Heart Foundation FFR versus angiography in guiding management to optimize outcomes in non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Yangsoo Jang on the IVUS-CTO trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing intravascular ultrasound-guided versus angiography-guided drug-eluting stent intervention in coronary chronic total occlusions. (Embargo lifts at 12:30 PM on September 14, 2014.) 3:00 PM 3:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Rino Sardella on the SMILE trial, comparing one-stage versus multistage revascularization in multivessel NSTEMI patients. (Embargo lifts at 1:00 PM on September 14, 2014.) 4:00 PM 4:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Pavel Cervinka on the OCT STEMI trial, a prospective, randomized study of optical coherence tomography guidance during primary PCI in acute myocardial infarction. (Embargo lifts at 12:30 PM on September 14, 2014.) 4:45 PM 5:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Fausto Feres and Dr. Laura Mauri on the TCT Crossfire debate: Three-month DAPT is all that is needed with DES. Monday, September 15, 2014 9:15 AM 9:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Keith Oldroyd and Dr. Ran Kornowski on the TCT Crossfire debate: Is nonculprit lesion treatment in STEMI warranted? 9:30 AM 10:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Steffen Desch on the Simplicity Flex trial, a prospective, randomized, sham-controlled trial of renal sympathetic denervation in patients with refractory hypertension. (Embargo lifts at 12:00 PM on September 16, 2014.) 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Paul Teirstein on the Maintenance of Certification Program. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Samir Kapadia on the PARTNER I trial, presenting five-year results from a prospective, randomized trial of transcatheter aortic valve replacement with a balloon-expandable device versus conservative care in extremely high-risk patients with aortic stenosis. (Embargo lifts at 12:00 PM on September 13, 2014.) 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Eric Dippel on the EXCITE ISR trial, a prospective, randomized study of excimer laser atherectomy versus balloon angioplasty for treating femoropopliteal in-stent restenosis. (Embargo lifts at 12:00 PM on September 16, 2014.) 11:30 AM 12:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Fernando Alfonso on the RIBS IV trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing paclitaxel-eluting balloons versus everolimus-eluting stents in patients with coronary in-stent restenosis of drug-eluting stents. (Embargo lifts at 12:00 PM on September 14, 2014.) 12:00 PM 12:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Juan Gaspar providing a wrap-up in Spanish. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Gregg Stone on the VELOCITY trial, a prospective, randomized study of peritoneal hypothermia in patients with acute STEMI undergoing PCI. (Embargo lifts at 12:36 PM on September 15, 2014.) 4:00 PM 4:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Giora Weisz providing a wrap-up in Hebrew. 4:30 PM 5:00 PM: Interview with Prof. Dr. Sigmund Silber providing a wrap-up in German. Tuesday, September 16, 2014 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Philippe Généreux providing a wrap-up in French. 9:30 AM 10:00 AM: Interview with Dr. Robert Byrne and Dr. Rod Stables providing a wrap-up from the UK/Ireland perspective. 10:15 AM 10:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Nicolo Piazza and Dr. Michael J. Mack on the TCT Crossfire debate: Should TAVR clinical indications expand to 'lower risk' patients? 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Interview with Dr. Jack Lewin on healthcare reform. 11:30 AM 12:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Nikolaus Sarafoff on the ISAR-TRIPLE trial, a prospective, randomized study comparing six weeks versus six months of clopidogrel in patients treated with concomitant aspirin and oral anticoagulant therapy following coronary drug-eluting stent implantation. (Embargo lifts at 12:06 PM on September 15, 2014.) 12:00 PM 12:30 PM: Interview with Dr. Rino Sardella providing a wrap-up in Italian. 5:30 PM 6:00 PM: Interview with Dr. Ajay Kirtane providing the TCT Daily Wrap-Up. This detailed schedule provides a comprehensive overview of the planned interviews and topics for TCT 2014.
